selection_scope: Bonta-selected anchor types, not held-out texts
normalization: SLP1 vowel length, stops within place including voicing/aspiration, all sibilants, retroflex/dental n; fixed Table 18 variants

consistency_intersection.scope: All dictionary headwords, no name/title semantic filter; order of the same three suffixes cannot change an intersection

coverage.warning: Roles pool illustrated allographs; 6/55 is a role-count indicator, not token or inscription coverage

limitations: Panel selected by Bonta for lexical fit before this test
Entire developmental search and plausible unattested compounds are not modelled
